test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Train P, going at the speed of 51 km/hr, completely passes Train Q of length 225 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks, at 22 km/hr, in 7.5 minutes. How much time (in seconds) will P take to completely cross Train R of length 420 m, going at 21 km/hr in the opposite direction?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of P = 51 km/hr

Speed of Q = 22 km/hr

Time = 7.5 minutes

Length of Q = 225 m

Speed of R = 21 km/hr

Length of R = 420 m

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (same direction) = difference of speeds

Relative speed (opposite direction) = sum of speeds

Time = distance ÷ speed

Speed conversion: km/hr × 5/18 = m/s
